fields.Name: T221 - Resource Access Domain Switch Populates Resource Types
fields.Description: Exercises OnDomainChanged -> loadResourceTypesForDomain, which repopulates the ResourceTypes list from PermissionEngine.GetResourceTypes for the newly chosen domain and clears an invalid ResourceTypeInput. This domain->resource-type dependency is unique to Resource Access and has no analog in the other tabs.

InputDefinition.goal: You are logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the Permissions app via the application switcher next to the logo, then click the 'Resource Access' item in the left nav. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. The surface shows a 'Domain:' dropdown, a 'Resource Type:' combobox, and a 'Resource ID:' text input. Open the 'Domain:' dropdown and select a different permission domain. Success is that the 'Resource Type:' combobox RESPONDS to the domain change — its selectable options update to that domain's resource types (open the combobox to confirm it lists options, or note it auto-fills a single type), and any previously-typed resource type that doesn't belong to the new domain is cleared. Seeing the combobox react to the domain selection is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Resource Access surface renders with Domain dropdown, Resource Type combobox, and Resource ID input
Changing the Domain selection updates the Resource Type combobox options (or auto-selects a single type / clears a now-invalid prior value)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
